title: APT 77 - Call Back - Alternative hip-hop duo APT 77  has conveyed a fresh new visual
htmlContent:
Alternative hip-hop duo APT 77  has conveyed a fresh new visual for their single “Call Back.” After numerous hours of perfecting his craft, he is ready to take the music industry head-on and show the globe what he has to offer.

“Call Back” showcase his exceptional style, incorporating complex rhymes over top of three different types, vocals styles, and percussion that gives it a good bounce that just makes you want to wobble. 

Overall, “Call Back” is a delightful release from APT 77 that embodies his distinctive style. There is no limit to where APT 77 could take this thing, and with the swiftness, they have reverberated.

APT 77 “Call Back” is available on all streaming outlets!
